model: Codex / GPT family (exact model identifier unavailable)
review_scope: Independent source review of root-authored packet_cli.py, packet_rehearsal.py and tests/test_packet_cli.py; frozen core/adapter identities included with prior separate decoder_review source review. No source edits during this review.
observations: CLI takes explicit local packet/image-map files, validates via the core, binds loaded bytes to packet image digests, and requires exact map membership before issuing output.
A command snapshots each image once; exact recompile verification uses those captured bytes. Receipt checks do not assert ongoing file validity after the command.
JSON output is exclusively created, preserving existing files. Input and verification failures produce no successful JSON output.

Rehearsal computes and checks nine synthetic cases plus an in-memory S3-shaped fixture before creating the output directory; all generated artifacts are covered by a deterministic inventory except the inventory itself.
Rehearsal validates all expected action outcomes and exact receipts, explicitly distinguishes the intentionally rejected input, and retains false business/AWS authority.
CLI tests execute real subprocesses, propagate actual Python -O when requested, check deterministic output and inventory digests, and preserve existing operator files.
Frozen core retains donor schemas/actions, rejects malformed or empty requirements, bounds structured input, and reads provider streams through EOF without writing to AWS.
limitations: Dimension checks follow OpenCV decoding; encoded-byte and postdecode dimensions are data limits, not a native-process peak-memory sandbox.
Fixtures establish deterministic measured behavior, not natural-image accuracy, correct viewpoint, authentic capture or calibrated production thresholds.
Provider completeness is tested with fake read-only bodies; no AWS provider runtime or OpenCV5 execution was performed.
Write errors can leave a newly created partial output; exclusive creation preserves prior operator files but is not an atomic multi-file transaction.
